      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          PYCODE

          python tools/hu_current_medium_coverage.py --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage.json"
          bash tools/hu_exact_batch_audit.sh "$registry"

        if: hashFiles('trainer/data/nl2_hu_b636_locked_medium.json') != ''
        with:
